scope.title: Cross-layer closed loop + multi-component controlled ablation

decision.reason: One deterministic integration test chains the shipped components end to end (breaker -> reliability -> recovery action -> eval sample -> verifier refusal -> single write owner -> recovery) and re-runs the E02 paired ablation with the verdict unchanged. No safety boundary is weakened.

steps: G03 eval sample before-fix fail/after-fix pass
